en: A black and white image showing a panoramic view of a coastal town nestled between mountains and the sea. The town is densely built along the coastline with buildings stretching up the slopes. A winding coastal road can be seen in the foreground with cypress trees and various traditional Mediterranean houses. The sea and part of the harbor are clearly visible. The text on the postcard appears in Greek and French, indicating the location and possibly describing the port and the upper part of the town.
